title: Big Pumpkins
hook: The data this week comes from BigPumpkins.com. The Great Pumpkin Commonwealth's (GPC) mission cultivates the hobby of growing giant pumpkins throughout the world by establishing standards and regulations that ensure quality of fruit, fairness of competition, recognition of achievement, fellowship and education for all participating growers and weigh-off sites. Types: F = "Field Pumpkin", P = "Giant Pumpkin", S = "Giant Squash", W = "Giant Watermelon", L = "Long Gourd" (length in inches, not weight in pounds), T = Tomato Great Pumpkin Commonwealth rule book
